title: Selected Topics in Architectural Technology; AI in Design: Buildings, Landscapes, Cities
description: Description: AI in Design: Buildings, Landscapes, and Cities teaches students how to use AI as a practical tool for design thinking and visual exploration. Students will work across multiple AI platforms to create and refine ideas at the scale of buildings, landscapes, and cities. Emphasis is placed on developing real-world skills to visualize, evaluate, and iterate designs quickly in 2D and 3D.
